what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nicaragua in Panama: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2811 Nicaraguan asylum seekers in Panama, 1.0% of all asylum seekers from Nicaragua.
Refugees from Nicaragua, a separate group, live mostly in Costa Rica, the United States, Spain and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Nicaragua, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 14 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7550, at the end of 2019, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Panama.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Panama only.
